name: Blackheart's Bay
theme: Collect Doubloons from chests and mercenary camps to pay Captain Blackheart to bombard enemy structures.
firstObjective: Chests spawn at 1:30 (3:00 respawn after final chest is cleared, paused during bombardment)
spawnPattern: 3 chest locations total: 1 chest in the first phase, 2 chests across the next three phases, and all 3 chests every phase after

mechanic.title: Doubloon Turn-In & Ghost Ship Bombardment
mechanic.description: Break Treasure Chests and capture Mercenary or Doubloon camps to gather Doubloons, then channel at Captain Blackheart in the central docks to turn them in and trigger a 12-cannonball bombardment against enemy structures. Turning in coins takes 5 seconds, the initial turn-in requirement is reduced (8 Doubloons, scaling up on subsequent turn-ins), bombardment damage to Keeps and Cores is reduced, and dying drops only half your carried Doubloons (rounded down).

camps.name: Doubloon Camps (4 Camps)
camps.notes: Quick camps that grant Doubloons directly on capture without pushing a lane.

camps.name: Siege Giants (3 Camps)
camps.notes: Grants Doubloons on capture and provides ranged siege pressure against structures.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Grants Doubloons on capture and pushes lanes with heavy frontliners and Spell Armor support.

camps.name: Boss / Grave Golem (1 Camp)
camps.notes: Located in the upper area pushing top lane; grants Doubloons and applies heavy lane pressure.

strategy: Blackheart's Bay revolves around efficient wave soaking, camp rotations, and contesting turn-in sight towers around the central docks. Because sight towers now sit on the flanks near Blackheart rather than north/south lane watchtower spots, controlling vision around the turn-in heavily shapes when your team can safely bank coins. Pair lane/camp pressure with turn-ins to force enemies into split choices.
notes: Sight towers flank Captain Blackheart's turn-in area rather than sitting north and south of the lanes, and watchtowers reset to neutral after 45 seconds unoccupied—keep an eye on turn-in vision before committing to a channel. Because dying only drops half your coins (rounded down), aggressive skirmishing around chests and turn-ins is slightly less punishing than full coin-drop rules used to be.
